Headteacher's Welcome
About Us
Welcome to St Peter's CE Primary Cowfold.
As Headteacher it is my great pleasure to welcome you to St Peter’s Church of England (Aided) Primary School. St Peter’s is a happy, caring village school in the heart of Cowfold, West Sussex. As we are a Church of England Primary School we have a strong, distinctively Christian ethos. By showing pupils how Christian values make a positive difference to the way we live our lives, the school community effectively helps our children ‘Love, Learn and Aim High’.
We hope you find the information you require on our website. If you do not, or need a paper copy of any document, please don't hesitate to contact Mrs King or Mrs Bell in the school office. Thank you.
You are always welcome at St Peter’s.

School Closures - Remote Learning
Parents
Remote Learning for School Closures
Remote learning refers to learning that is completed away from the physical school building. This would be needed if the school has to close for extreme weather or if the heating / water fails.
At St Peter’s C of E Primary School, we understand the need to continually deliver high quality education, including during periods of remote working whether for an individual pupil, a specific group or for the whole school due to local or national lockdowns or other school closures. We recognise the importance of maintaining high expectations in all areas of school life and ensuring that all pupils have access to the learning resources and support they need to succeed.
